description: Reusable configuration for a bug triage council. Personas classify and prioritize open issues by severity, priority, and remediation sequencing.

severity_rubric.critical: Blocks core flow OR exposes sensitive data OR causes data loss
severity_rubric.high: Breaks important flow OR significantly degrades UX OR security risk
severity_rubric.medium: Inconveniences users OR has clear workaround OR cosmetic-but-noticeable
severity_rubric.low: Cosmetic OR rare edge case OR minor inconvenience

assignment_rules.security_severity: always assign to security-privacy-reviewer for review
assignment_rules.performance_severity: always assign to performance-skeptic for review
assignment_rules.data_severity: always assign to data-steward for review
